text: Church's thesis in constructive mathematics (CT) is the axiom that every total function ℕ→ℕ is:
choices: computable by a Turing machine (i.e., has a Gödel index)
explanation: CT₀ (Kleene's Church-Thesis as axiom): all total functions ℕ→ℕ are recursive. In Russian constructivism and Markov's school, CT is adopted as an axiom.
